intro.en: I work on multimodal retrieval, generative models, and the evaluation of language models. Currently, I am exploring video-to-music generation.
intro.zh: 我的研究与项目经历涵盖多模态检索、生成模型与大模型评测，目前正在探索视频到音乐生成。

bio.en: I am an MPhil student in Data Science and Analytics at HKUST (Guangzhou), with a BEng in Artificial Intelligence from Wuhan University. Previously, I worked as a research assistant at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and HKUST (Guangzhou).
bio.zh: 我目前在香港科技大学（广州）攻读数据科学与应用研究型硕士，本科毕业于武汉大学人工智能专业。此前曾在香港理工大学及香港科技大学（广州）担任研究助理。
